feeds.title: Seacoast Oldies » Oldies
feeds.description: Read posts about oldies news written by music newsgroup, Andrea Dresdale. The greatest hits are on Seacoast Oldies! Serving the seacoast of NH and southern Maine with all the good old times.

feeds.title: Mehfil Mein Meri
feeds.description: The Mehfil Mein Meri blog takes you on a nostalgic journey through the Golden Era Of Hindi Film Music. Created by Dr. Anup to share his passion and memories of old Hindi songs, this blog is a way to express his thoughts on the same. He also shares snippets about the singers, the lyricists, the music directors, and the whole old Hindi cinema as such.

feeds.title: The Vintage Music Blog
feeds.description: Keeping the music of the past ALIVE!...from the Golden Eras of the 1920's, 1930's, 1940's, 1950's and 1960's including Big Band, Dance Orchestras, Swing, Crooners, Nostalgic, Popular Artists and Harmony Groups plus Contemporary, Retro and Revival artists.

feeds.title: Old Grey Cat Blog
feeds.description: Jeff Gemmill is a middle-aged white guy with catholic tastes, who writes about music reviews, memories, and related ephemera.

feeds.title: 2 Loud 2 Old Music
feeds.description: A blog about music. Whether it is Rock, Metal, Pop, Christian, Country, New Classical, Motown, Jazz, R&B, Hip-Hop, or whatever else is out there. Here, you'll find album reviews, artists' profiles, music news and so much more.

feeds.title: Do You Remember » Music
feeds.description: Read about the legends, old music, and more. DoYouRemember? is home to the largest online community of nostalgia enthusiasts and is the go-to website for fans of the '50s '60s, '70s, and '80s.
